name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
description: The EZ-bar skull crusher replaces the straight bar with an EZ-curl bar, reducing wrist and elbow stress while maintaining tricep loading similar to the barbell version. The angled grip positions of the EZ-bar allow a more natural hand angle during the movement. It is the most common skull crusher variation for high-volume training due to its superior comfort and reduced injury risk over straight bar versions.

execution.starting_position: Lie on a flat bench, EZ-bar pressed to full extension above the chest. Grip the inner handles.
execution.setup_instructions: Have a spotter hand the EZ-bar off or unrack from a low rack. Use the inner grips of the EZ-bar.
steps: Step 1: Begin with EZ-bar fully extended above the chest.
Step 2: Keeping upper arms vertical, lower the EZ-bar toward the forehead by bending only the elbows.
Step 3: Lower to just above the forehead.
Step 4: Extend the elbows to return to the starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Inhale on the descent, exhale on the press.
common_mistakes: Upper arms drifting forward or backward during the movement
safety_considerations: EZ-bar still requires careful attention at the bottom — do not go to failure without a spotter
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension to bar just above the forehead.
coaching_cues: Upper arms pinned — only elbows move
